Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class BarColumnGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.BarColumnGameTests
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
public final class BarColumnGameTests extends Object implements net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
Bar support and collapse in a live level: item validity, grounding at the bottom of a column, footprint overlap deciding support across the alternating layer orientations, and the difference between player extraction, which drops what it unsupports, and automated extraction, which backfills from the top instead.

    • backfillKeepsABarItWouldNoLongerAccept

      public void backfillKeepsABarItWouldNoLongerAccept(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Validity gates insertion only, so a bar stored before a data pack reload narrowed the rule has to survive the backfill an automated extraction moves it through. A stick stands in for such a bar: a Bar Stack refuses one from a deposit, but may be holding contents the current ingot set no longer covers.

      To reproduce in-game: fill a Bar Stack, narrow the ingot rule so one stored bar is no longer accepted, then automate extraction below it. Backfill retains or drops that legacy bar without deleting or changing it.
